category_title: Students who engage in disruptive behavior to avoid difficult academic tasks
scenario_title: Difficult reading assignment in ELA class
minimal_context: David is presented with a reading assignment during his English Language Arts class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: David, it is time for ELA. Please read this passage and complete the assignment at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stares at the paper) I'm not reading this. It's too long.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to do your work. Just get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the assignment off the desk) No! I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: David, pick up your paper right now or I will have to send you to the office.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't give a s***! Send me to the office, I'm not doing this f***ing reading!
